verdict.rationale: Cursor's own docs say Bugbot analyzes every PR for bugs and also for security vulnerabilities, posting inline comments with explanations and fixes, so security findings come alongside functional bugs. Beyond that generic claim, the depth of security detection is unproven, and community reports corroborate only general bug-finding. missing for 10: documented detection of injection risks, leaked secrets and insecure patterns specifically, any security-focused examples or benchmarks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of security findings.

support.subject: As a security engineer, reviews flag security problems in the diff — injection risks, leaked secrets, insecure patterns — alongside functional bugs

citations.quote: It analyzes every pull request for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues, leaving inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes.
Bugbot reviews pull requests and identifies bugs, security issues, and code quality problems.
Bugbot analyzes PR diffs and leaves comments with explanations and fix suggestions.
